_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A provider's Connect cannot be dismissed while it is saving. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". The server is faked: there are no models and no providers. Connecting a provider waits until call "release", then saves "Pending account". Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The form" is the element with data-testid "model-provider-form". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and open the model picker. Click the button named "Manage Models", then the button named "+ Add Models". 2. Fill the form's data-testid "provider-api-key" input with "secret" and its data-testid "provider-display-name" input with "Pending account". 3. Click the form's button named "Connect". The form's button named "Saving…" should be disabled, and data-testid "model-mode-single" should be disabled. 4. Click the button whose name contains "Close modal" inside the last element with role "dialog": the form should still be visible. 5. Press Escape: the form should still be visible. 6. Call "release". 7. The form should be hidden, and data-testid "provider-connection" should contain the text "Pending account".
